svg.title: IUPC: flat pressure trace despite palpable contractions, then a verified trace
svg.desc: Six-minute synthetic strip. FHR about 140 bpm with moderate variability. For the first 3 minutes the IUPC trace is flat at 15 mmHg while hatched bars mark contractions felt at 1 and 2.5 minutes. After the system and catheter position are assessed and the signal verified at 3 minutes, resting pressure is 15 mmHg and contractions at 4 and 5.5 minutes peak at 65 and 70 mmHg.
svg.text: Flat at 15 mmHg: palpation and trace disagree
